data_description.update_interval: How often Home Assistant polls the inverter for power data. Lower values give faster updates but keep the BLE link busy. Minimum: 5 s.
data_description.timeout: Maximum time to wait for a BLE response before marking the request as failed. Minimum: 5 s.
data_description.rated_power_w: Rated peak output power of your inverter in Watt (e.g. 800 for HiFlow 800). Set to 0 to disable the Watt-based power limit slider. If your model is not auto-detected, report your inverter serial number prefix at the GitHub issue tracker.

user.title: Add HiFlow inverter
user.description: Pick a discovered RMI-* device, or choose "Enter address manually…" if your inverter is not listed. Make sure the S-Miles app is not connected.

manual.title: Add HiFlow inverter manually
manual.description: Enter the inverter's Bluetooth MAC address and serial number. Use this when the device is reachable only through a Bluetooth proxy that does not forward the advertised name.

data.sn: Serial number or BLE name (e.g. RMI-4161A38A)

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description:
About to pair with {name} ({address}). Make sure the S-Miles app is fully closed — the inverter only accepts one Bluetooth connection at a time.

Enter the BLE PIN you set in the S-Miles app (the one you enter when the app asks for a PIN to connect via Bluetooth).

error.cannot_connect: Bluetooth connection failed. Is the inverter in range?
error.pairing_failed: Pairing handshake failed. Close the S-Miles app and try again.
error.no_devices: No HiFlow devices discovered. Make sure Bluetooth is enabled and the inverter is in range.
error.invalid_address: Enter a valid Bluetooth MAC address.
error.invalid_serial: Enter a valid serial number or RMI-* BLE name.
